name: Streak board (daily check-in)
use_when: a group keeps a daily habit together and wants to see who kept it up: gym, runs, leetcode, reading, no-phone mornings
'streak', 'check in every day', 'day 1 of', 'who went today', 'loser buys smoothies Sunday'
one check-in per person per day; streaks and a weekly stake matter
dont_use_when: a one-time headcount for one event (use lock)
a list of tasks to finish once (use claims)
finding a time to meet (use overlap)
guarantees: one check-in per person per day; the day comes from the server time at a fixed UTC offset and day-start hour, never from a phone
a current streak counts days in a row ending today, or yesterday until today is missed; best is the longest run kept
only today's own check-in can be taken back; nobody can check in for someone else or backfill a day
a leaver's row goes; a late joiner starts at zero and can check in at once

stake.description: The weekly stake as one plain line from the chat, e.g. 'Fewest days by Sunday buys smoothies', or empty

utcOffsetMinutes.description: The group's fixed UTC offset in minutes: -480 Pacific, -420 Mountain, -360 Central, -300 Eastern

dayStartsAt.description: Hour the day starts, 0 to 23; 4 means check-ins before 4 AM count for the day before

examples.title: Run club 30 day challenge
examples.stake: Fewest runs this week buys Philz on Sunday
